verdict.rationale: Channel3's own API returns structured product metadata (pricing, variants, images and merchant offers) from any product URL under a consistent cross-retailer schema, and includes buy URLs in search responses. Availability is never documented, though. Hands-on reports of missing prices and a price shown as '0' point to uneven data quality rather than an absent capability. Missing for 10: documented availability/stock fields, a published OpenAPI schema (probe found none), and evidence of consistent price completeness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read machine-readable offer data — price, availability, variants, checkout links — for any listed product or service

citations.quote: Pass any product URL and get structured metadata: pricing, variants, images, and merchant offers in a single response.
Structured product data, with a consistent schema across retailers
Channel3 appends it to buy URLs in the response.
